whole_files_read.method: Exact byte-equivalent GPLv3 text reused from imagedup491 complete-source review

findings: Root LICENSE is exact-byte GPLv3 text, SHA256 matching prior fully reviewed imagedup491 LICENSE. This does not establish bundled DLL/font licensing or provenance; no code adopted.
Editorconfig defines style rules with later cs/vb overrides, including final-newline preference overriding earlier false for C#. These are formatting settings, not quality/runtime checks.

Gitattributes normalizes text automatically and marks linux_build.sh -text. Gitignore is a Visual Studio/macOS/Windows template plus global *.svg exclusion; no execution or package installation performed.
